sourcedFrom: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English (undated — no copyright line is printed)
cleanIntro: The LeMat is not like the other cap-and-ball revolvers in this book. Its RIFLED BARREL UNSCREWS — there is no wedge and no cylinder pin to pull.

steps.title: Carry it unloaded — it has no safety at all
steps.action: Before anything else, understand what you are holding. Pietta states that on this model there are no safety devices and no safety positions of any kind. There is no notch to rest a hammer in. Confirm every chamber and the shot barrel are empty and uncapped before you touch a screw.
steps.quote: LEMAT MODEL For this model there are no safety devices or safety positions. ALWAYS carry this gun unloaded.
steps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — SAFETY POSITIONS, LeMat Model, p.15
steps.warn: ALWAYS MAKE SURE THE REVOLVER IS COMPLETELY UNLOADED BEFORE CLEANING.

steps.title: Clean it after every session, without exception
steps.action: Black powder residue is hygroscopic and starts corroding the moment it cools. Pietta makes this an instruction rather than advice: the gun gets cleaned after each shooting session. Eye protection on — there are spring-loaded parts in here.
steps.caution: WEAR SAFETY GLASSES IN CASE YOU LOSE CONTROL OF SOME SPRING-LOADED COMPONENT WHICH COULD INJURE YOUR EYES.
steps.quote: YOUR MUZZLELOADING FIREARM MUST BE CLEANED AFTER EACH SHOOTING SESSION TO PREVENT RUST AND CORROSION FROM DAMAGING THE METAL PARTS.
steps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — Care and Cleaning, caution, p.29

steps.title: Grips off first
steps.action: Start at the grips, not at the barrel. Take out the screw through the middle of the grip panels and lift them off. The LeMat's procedure begins here, which is the first sign that this is not the open-top or full-frame sequence printed on the same pages.
steps.prose: The sentence continues 'unscrewing the screw located in the middle of same.'
steps.quote: To clean the gun thoroughly, remove the grips (part no. 48/49) by
steps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — INITIAL CLEANING PROCEDURE FOR THE LEMAT REVOLVER, step 1, p.30

steps.title: Barrel locking stud or bracket off
steps.action: Remove either the barrel locking stud or the barrel bracket, depending which your gun carries — Pietta names both because both were made. This is what frees the barrel to turn.
steps.quote: Remove the barrel locking stud (part no. 9A) or the barrel bracket
steps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — INITIAL CLEANING PROCEDURE FOR THE LEMAT REVOLVER, step 2, p.30

steps.title: Unscrew the rifled barrel, then the cylinder slides off
steps.action: Unscrew the rifled barrel from the frame and slide the cylinder off the shot barrel it turns around. This is the LeMat's defining mechanism: the lower shot barrel IS the cylinder's axis, so the rifled barrel has to come off before the cylinder can. Do not look for a wedge or a cylinder pin — there is neither.
steps.quote: Unscrew the rifled barrel (part no. 8) and slide off the cylinder.
steps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — INITIAL CLEANING PROCEDURE FOR THE LEMAT REVOLVER, step 3, p.30
steps.warn: ⛔ Pietta prints four different revolver procedures across pp.29-31. The wedge, the cylinder-pin pull and the tilting-frame reassembly all belong to OTHER patterns and must not be applied here.

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Grips, barrel stud or bracket, rifled barrel and cylinder are off. Pietta then sends you to the same cleaning it prescribes for the other black powder revolvers — solvent or hot water, dried thoroughly, lightly oiled.
steps.quote: Dry all parts thoroughly and lubricate lightly with gun oil. Do not apply the oil heavily as this will contribute to additional fouling during shooting and require more cleaning between shots.
steps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — Care and Cleaning, common procedure, p.29

deepSteps.title: The sear adjustment screw, and what it actually does
deepSteps.action: One adjustment is published for this gun and it is worth knowing before you meet it. The sear adjustment screw on the right side of the frame sets when the cylinder stop stud releases: screwing it in slows the release, unscrewing it brings the release forward. That is cylinder timing, so change it in small increments and check the cylinder locks up on every chamber afterwards.
deepSteps.caution: This screw controls when the cylinder stop releases. Adjust it a little at a time and verify the cylinder locks on every chamber before firing.
deepSteps.quote: The sear adjustment screw (part no. 16) located in the right side of the frame should be used to set up the cylinder locking.
deepSteps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — INITIAL CLEANING PROCEDURE FOR THE LEMAT REVOLVER, SPECIAL TIP, p.30

deepSteps.title: Everything metal, solvent or hot water
deepSteps.action: With the gun apart, clean every metal part with a good quality black powder solvent or with plenty of hot water. Hot water is a genuine option here, not a compromise — black powder fouling is water soluble and the heat drives the drying. What matters is that nothing goes back together damp.
deepSteps.prose: The sentence continues 'solvent or with plenty of hot water.'
deepSteps.quote: Carefully clean all the metal parts with a good quality black powder
deepSteps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — Care and Cleaning, common procedure, p.29

deepSteps.title: Dry thoroughly, oil sparingly
deepSteps.action: Dry every part completely and then oil lightly. Heavy oil on a black powder gun is counterproductive: it binds with fouling during shooting and makes the next clean worse, which Pietta says in as many words.
deepSteps.quote: Dry all parts thoroughly and lubricate lightly with gun oil. Do not apply the oil heavily as this will contribute to additional fouling during shooting and require more cleaning between shots.
deepSteps.cite: F.lli Pietta Black Powder Instruction and Safety Manual (English) — avancarica, English — Care and Cleaning, common procedure, p.29

cleaning.name: BARRELS & CHAMBERS
tasks: Clean the rifled barrel and the lower shot barrel separately — they foul differently
Clean each chamber of the cylinder with black powder solvent or plenty of hot water
Dry everything thoroughly before any oil goes near it

cleaning.name: METAL PARTS
tasks: Carefully clean all the metal parts with a good quality black powder solvent or with plenty of hot water
Dry all parts thoroughly and lubricate lightly with gun oil
Do not apply the oil heavily — heavy oil contributes to additional fouling during shooting

cleaning.name: NIPPLES & CAP AREA
tasks: Clear fouling from around the nipples where caps have been fired
Wipe the recoil shield and the hammer face
Confirm nothing is left damp anywhere before reassembly

reassembly: Slide the cylinder back onto the shot barrel, then thread the rifled barrel back onto the frame.
Refit the barrel locking stud or the barrel bracket, whichever your gun carries.
Refit the grips and their centre screw.

⛔ Do not use the 'seat the rear of the cylinder first or the frame will not close' instruction printed further down the same page — that belongs to the Starr, which has a tilting top frame. The LeMat has neither.
fncheck: With the revolver confirmed unloaded and uncapped, check the cylinder turns and locks on every chamber, and that the rifled barrel is fully threaded home against the frame. Remember this model has no safety position of any kind.
